_purpose: Which workloads have run on which part, and the log that proves it.
Eleven kernel modules carried 'STATUS: UNTESTED ON HARDWARE' in their
docstrings on 2026-09-10, and every one of them had run on a
trn1.2xlarge -- some of them a fortnight earlier. A status line that
nothing checks is not a status, and in a repo whose rule is 'never
claim a kernel works without a hardware run behind it', the inverse
error matters just as much: a stale UNTESTED label makes verified
work look unverified, and leaves a reader unable to tell which of
So the record moves out of prose and into here, where
tests/test_hardware_status.py can hold the docstrings against it.
A workload is listed only if a run produced a PASS or a SKIP for it.
A FAIL is not a hardware verification -- it is evidence the kernel
reached the device, which is a different and lesser claim -- so
moe_router and transformer_train_step are recorded under the pass
that fixed them, not the one that found them.

Publication pass, group 300x3: three trn1.2xlarge at 3ae6426, one harness process per suite, --duration 300 --repeat 3. 23 PASS on all three hosts (baseline_metrics not listed), 0 FAIL, 2 SKIPPED. 21 of 23 scored workloads agree across hosts within 0.2%; allocation_fragmentation 6.9% and pcie_bandwidth 2.5% do not. Per-host reports under data/publication-2026-09-21/trn1/.

Publication pass, group 3600: the same three hosts, --duration 3600, one repeat. memory_read, memory_write, pcie_bandwidth and transformer_virus PASS on all three; memory_read 273.1 GB/s against 273.0 at 300 s. memory_read_agg and memory_write_agg FAIL on all three with 'core 0 timed out; core 1 timed out': the aggregate's worker budget was a fixed 1800 s, a harness bug fixed in #25 -- see the 3600-fixed entry. Same hosts also ran the size sweep (group sweep): memory_read flat 272.8-273.1 GB/s from 1 to 12 GiB; memory_write PASS to 4 GiB, and out of device memory at 8 and 12, the constraint its pin exists for (#32).

Publication pass, group 3600-fixed: memory_read_agg and memory_write_agg at --duration 3600 on one of the pass's trn1.2xlarge, from the #25 branch (memory_agg.py hash-checked on the host). memory_read 273.12 and memory_write 254.57 GB/s by neuron-profile over total_active_time, each with the same 2.07-2.09 ms idle startup trn1 shows; pcie_bandwidth 2.16 GB/s.
